name: Spectra Play
description:
Spectra Play is a modern music player with GPU-accelerated visuals. Point it at your own audio and watch it come alive with a choice of nine real-time visualizers rendered in WebGL2.

How it works. You pick a folder of music and the app lists everything inside it — loading a whole directory at once and remembering it for next time. As a track plays through the audio engine, the app continuously analyses the sound, splitting it into a live frequency…
